name: Customize - Create a Local Admin Account
description: Creates a user and password of your choosing, please note that this will show in the log as CLEAR text.  This is nice for a lab or testing, or if you have LAPS change it after.

options.name: ConfigUserName
options.description: Set the User Name you'd like to create. ie: BC Bob

options.name: ConfigUserPassword
options.description: Set the password you'd like for the account. ie: P@ssw0rd

options.name: script
